detail.error: no NDTwin route binding for this write
detail.remedy: declare roles.ipv4_route in the package, or use POST /p4/table_entry
detail.message: switch 1: refusing an ipv4_lpm route insert -- this switch runs the app package's own pipeline and the package declares no roles.ipv4_route, so NDTwin does not know which of its tables is a route table and writes none of them
